title: Deep Negative Binomial Autoregression for Sparse Spatio-Temporal Counts: Estimation and Predictive Distribution Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2611.29207v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study estimation and probabilistic forecasting for sparse, overdispersed count panels using DeepNB-STAR, a negative binomial autoregression whose log-mean and log-size are outputs of a deep ReLU network of temporal and neighboring summaries of the past, fitted by maximum likelihood. We prove an oracle inequality for the Hellinger risk along the observed trajectory without mixing assumptions, rates governed by compositional smoothness with a matching lower bound for a H\"older subclass, geometric absolute regularity, and bounds on the error of h-step predictive distributions of order h^{1/2} times the root estimation risk plus a Monte Carlo term. All results hold for a size that depends on the covariates, and the estimation bounds hold under arbitrary dependence between sites, with the number of time points as sample size. translated_title: 用于稀疏时空计数的深度负二项自回归：估计与预测分布界
translated_abstract: 我们研究稀疏、过度离散计数面板数据的估计与概率预测问题，提出DeepNB-STAR——一种负二项自回归模型，其对数均值与对数尺度参数是深度ReLU网络的输出，该网络以过去观测的时间性摘要和邻域摘要作为输入，并通过极大似然进行拟合。我们证明了沿观测轨迹的Hellinger风险的oracle不等式，无需混合性假设，其收敛速率由复合光滑性决定，并对某个Hölder子类给出了匹配的下界；同时证明了模型具有几何绝对正则性，以及h步预测分布误差的界，其阶为h^{1/2}乘以估计风险的平方根再加上蒙特卡洛误差项。所有结果均适用于依赖于协变量的尺度参数，且估计界在站点之间任意相关的情况下仍然成立，并以时间点数量作为样本量。在四个日本传染病监测面板数据上，DeepNB-STAR的加权区间分数比对照方法低0.6%至1.0%（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出深度负二项自回归模型DeepNB-STAR用于稀疏、过度离散的时空计数数据，首次在无混合性假设且允许站点间任意依赖的条件下建立了Hellinger风险的oracle不等式、几何绝对正则性以及h步预测分布误差的理论界，并在日本监测数据上取得了更优的预测性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DeepNB-STAR, a deep negative binomial autoregression for sparse overdispersed spatio-temporal counts, and establishes oracle inequalities for Hellinger risk without mixing assumptions, geometric absolute regularity, and h-step predictive distribution error bounds under arbitrary between-site dependence.
